phrases.english: After tomorrow, I will speak Chinese all day with you.
phrases.other: 明天以后，我会整天和你说中文。

phrases.english: I believe all of them want to see this place.
phrases.other: 我相信他们都想看这个地方。

phrases.english: They like to practice with people who speak well.
phrases.other: 他们喜欢和说得好的人练习。

phrases.english: Because I think that making mistakes is a good thing.
phrases.other: 因为我觉得犯错是好事。

phrases.english: I am trying to learn to speak Chinese as often as possible now.
phrases.other: 我现在在试着尽量多学说中文。

phrases.english: Soon she will easily start speaking Chinese more with us.
phrases.other: 很快她会容易开始和我们多说中文了。

phrases.english: She said she would come here tomorrow morning.
phrases.other: 她说她明天早上会来这里。

phrases.english: At present I do not have time to chat with you about this
phrases.other: 我目前没有时间和你聊这

phrases.english: I am not sure if I can finish learning tomorrow with you.
phrases.other: 我不确定我明天能不能和你学完。

phrases.english: I have a few things I really want to ask you about today.
phrases.other: 我今天有几个事真的很想问你。

phrases.english: I believe afternoon is better for us to meet.
phrases.other: 我相信下午我们见面更好。

phrases.english: She saw me at this place and was very kind to me.
phrases.other: 她在这个地方看到我对我很好。

phrases.english: We were waiting when she arrived at this place.
phrases.other: 她到这个地方的时候我们在等着。

phrases.english: Do you mind if I stay here at this place a little longer?
phrases.other: 你介意我在这个地方多待一点吗？

phrases.english: It is useful to start talking quickly before you go.
phrases.other: 在你走之前尽快开始说话是有用的。

phrases.english: Soon she is not going to easily meet everyone at six o'clock.
phrases.other: 很快她不会六点容易和别人见面。

phrases.english: Because she does not want to take too much time to help us.
phrases.other: 因为她不想花太多时间来帮我们。

phrases.english: I am trying to learn how to say something in Chinese.
phrases.other: 我在试着学怎么用中文说一些东西。

phrases.english: I am going to practice speaking a little Chinese with you now.
phrases.other: 我现在要和你练习说一点中文。

phrases.english: He wasn't very patient when I couldn't answer.
phrases.other: 我回答不了的时候他不太有耐心。

phrases.english: But we do not want to stop until we meet everyone tomorrow.
phrases.other: 但是我们不想停止，明天见别人。

phrases.english: I am going to learn how to use Chinese now.
phrases.other: 我现在要学怎么用中文。

phrases.english: I then decided to go to her home to see her today.
phrases.other: 我今天就去了她家看她了。

phrases.english: Because he wants to quickly find out who the person is.
phrases.other: 因为他想快点找出是什么人。

phrases.english: Yes, she said she will come to my house tomorrow.
phrases.other: 是的，她说她明天会来我家。

phrases.english: We think this isn't hard so we'll be done after.
phrases.other: 我们觉得这个不难所以以后会做完。

phrases.english: She likes to learn by herself when she has enough time.
phrases.other: 她有够多时间的时候喜欢自己学。

phrases.english: Why does he want to quickly learn her name? Because soon he will meet her.
phrases.other: 他为什么想快点学她的名字？因为很快他会和她见面。

phrases.english: She said she is currently not able to go there with us
phrases.other: 她说她目前不能和我们去那儿

phrases.english: started (completed)
phrases.other: 开始了

phrases.english: I do not want to stop talking until I find out his answer.
phrases.other: 我不想停止说话，我想找出他的答案。

phrases.english: I am trying to say something in Chinese now.
phrases.other: 我现在在试着用中文说一些东西。

phrases.english: I am going to try to remember the meaning of a word in Chinese.
phrases.other: 我要试着记住中文词意思。

phrases.english: I think we can talk about something different today
phrases.other: 我觉得我们今天可以聊点不一样的

phrases.english: He said I hope this isn't too difficult for you.
phrases.other: 他说我希望这个对你不是太难。

phrases.english: That young man said his mother wants to meet you.
phrases.other: 那个年轻的男人说他妈妈想见你。

phrases.english: She hopes this work will be done very soon today.
phrases.other: 她希望这个工作今天会很快做完。

phrases.english: Soon she is going to help me remember his name easily.
phrases.other: 很快她要帮我容易记住他的名字了。

phrases.english: Yes, I want to learn Chinese with you today.
phrases.other: 是的，我今天想和你学中文。

phrases.english: nearly ready (completed)
phrases.other: 快要了

phrases.english: I am certain that learning Chinese is meaningful.
phrases.other: 我确定学中文很有意思。

phrases.english: She said she couldn't answer that question just now.
phrases.other: 她说她刚才回答不了那个问题。

phrases.english: He said he does not have anything he must do today
phrases.other: 他说他今天没有什么必须做的

phrases.english: I think this place is where I left my keys yesterday
phrases.other: 我觉得这地方是我昨天留钥匙的地方

phrases.english: I want to be able to speak Chinese with you after today.
phrases.other: 我想今天以后能和你说中文。

phrases.english: I am trying to say something in Chinese as often as possible.
phrases.other: 我在试着用中文尽量多说一些东西。

phrases.english: I am afraid I left my things at that place yesterday
phrases.other: 恐怕我昨天把我的东西留在那地方了

phrases.english: When I tried I wasn't too nervous about it.
phrases.other: 我试着的时候我不太紧张。

phrases.english: He is always willing to offer help when needed.
phrases.other: 需要的时候他很想帮助。

phrases.english: She has a book she wants me to look at for a while
phrases.other: 她有一书她想我看一会儿
